pages.text: This Guardian guards the End itself. Even Ender Dragon is no match for him.$(br)It is located in the End.

pages.title: The Ruins of the Citadel
pages.text: Small ruins in the wastelands of Enda.

pages.title: Eye of Void
pages.text: It is necessary to search for the Ruins of the Citadel.

After going through a bunch of traps, shulkers and parasites called the Endermaptera, you will be greeted by mini-bosses, Ender golems, whose killing sounds like a small challenge. After exploring the dungeon, you will find a well that leads to the lower floor of the Ruins. As soon as you jump off, the Ender Guardian will appear.
He is twice as strong as the Ender Golem, and uses the energy of the End itself, which is able to move the target in space. If you lose a lot of health, its protection decreases. It has 2 phases.
Combined with his strong punches and End's energy, he is one of their strongest bosses.
